push.title: Push changes
push.description: By default PatchMan pushes your HEAD to a fresh branch and opens a merge request — it never moves your local branch or force-pushes.
push.mrTitlePlaceholder: Optional — defaults to the branch name
push.directWarning: Pushes your HEAD straight to this remote branch — no review. Use for your own topic branches.

resolver.malformedMarkers: The conflict markers in this file are incomplete or malformed. Resolve it by hand below, then Mark resolved.
resolver.noMarkers: No conflict markers found — this file looks already resolved on disk. Stage it to finish.
resolver.blockedByMarker: A resolved side still contains a conflict-marker line — use Edit on that block, or Edit raw, to remove it.
resolver.markResolvedTitle: Write the resolved file and stage it

resolver.stillHasMarkers: The file still contains conflict markers — remove them before marking resolved.
resolver.acceptAllCurrentTitle: Accept the current (ours) side for every conflict
resolver.acceptAllIncomingTitle: Accept the incoming (theirs) side for every conflict
resolver.editRawTitle: Edit the whole file by hand
resolver.showBaseTitle: Show the common ancestor (base) for this conflict
resolver.acceptBothTitle: Keep the current side, then the incoming side
resolver.editBlockTitle: Hand-edit the resolved text for this conflict

connDialog.description: Connect a GitLab instance to browse repositories, view the commit graph and (on desktop) clone locally. A personal access token is encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM and never returned in the clear.
connDialog.providerNote: GitLab is the only provider in v1.
connDialog.baseUrlNote: Your GitLab host — https://gitlab.com or a self-managed instance.
connDialog.authOauthNote: Reads run as the caller — each user links their own GitLab account in Settings.
connDialog.authPatNote: A stored token (api scope) shared by everyone granted this connection.
connDialog.thisDeviceDesc: Store on the embedded desktop BE. Required to clone repositories locally.
connDialog.patchmanServerDesc: Store on the team backend so grantees can browse it too.
connDialog.bothBackendsNote: The connection is saved to BOTH backends — the token is encrypted with each BE's own key. Pick which one it defaults to.
connDialog.patRequired: A personal access token is required
connDialog.patHelp: Create one in GitLab: avatar → Edit profile → Access Tokens (<path>{{host}}/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens</path>). The scopes it needs are listed under the field. It's shown only once — copy it immediately.
connDialog.patHelpAria: How to get a personal access token
connDialog.tokenExpired: GitLab says this token has expired. Create a new one and paste it here.
connDialog.tokenRevoked: GitLab says this token was revoked. Create a new one and paste it here.
connDialog.tokenInvalid: GitLab did not accept this token. Check that it belongs to this GitLab and was copied in full.
connDialog.tokenScope: The token is missing a scope it needs — see the list under the token field (usually api).
connDialog.patScopes: Scopes: api covers everything PatchMan does — browsing, merge request comments and approvals, clone, pull and push. Read-only: read_api + read_repository. A project or group token also needs read_repository (clone) and write_repository (push). Don't give it sudo, and use your own account, not an admin. CI/CD: read_api shows pipelines, logs and schedules; running, retrying or cancelling needs api. Reading CI/CD variables also needs the Maintainer role on the project.

shareDialog.title: Share "{{name}}"
shareDialog.description: Recipients act through this connection without ever seeing the stored token. Read = browse repositories, commit graph & diffs. Write is reserved for a later revision.

sidebar.title: Git connections
sidebar.deleteDescription: The connection and every grant under it are removed from all backends. This does not touch the GitLab project itself. This cannot be undone.

errors.pull: Could not pull the latest changes
errors.networkRemote: Can't reach the PatchMan server. Check your VPN or network connection.
errors.networkLocal: Can't reach PatchMan's backend on this computer. Restart the app if this keeps happening.

pull.title: Pull the latest from the remote (fast-forward)
pull.successDesc: The local clone is now up to date with the remote.

ci.selectPipeline: Pick a pipeline to see its jobs.
ci.selectJob: Pick a job to see its log.
ci.varsNeedWrite: CI/CD variables are often secrets, so they're shown only to people with write access on this connection. GitLab also requires the Maintainer role on the project.
ci.varsHint: Values stay hidden until you show them, one at a time (each look is recorded). Masked values are shown to Maintainers; hidden ones GitLab never returns.
